name: Fireflies.ai
description: Fireflies.ai records and transcribes meetings and audio files, and its paid plans add integrations, analytics and team features.
features: Zapier and app integrations on higher tiers
useCases: Searching what was said in past calls
strengths: The FAQ says there are no monthly rate limits on the meeting bot or Chrome extension
limitations: Prices and Free-plan limits were not readable on the page we fetched
Some features (API, dialers, bulk uploads) have rate limits

free.details: Free forever: unlimited transcription, limited AI summaries, 400 minutes of storage per team, 20 AI credits.

plans.name: Pro
plans.note: $10 per seat per month billed annually. A higher figure of $18 is shown beside it; the monthly view was not captured.

plans.name: Business
plans.note: $19 per seat per month billed annually. A higher figure of $29 is shown beside it; the monthly view was not captured.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.note: $39 per seat per month, annual billing only; contact sales.

pricing.regional: Currency and regional pricing: not stated in the text we could read. Check the official page for current prices.
notes: The official page said paid plans are charged per seat and to contact the company for more than 50 members.

verification.notes: Product active. Page opened with a Monthly/Annual toggle (save up to 44%). Billed annually per seat/month: Pro $10, Business $19, Enterprise $39 (annual only). A second, higher figure sits beside Pro ($18) and Business ($29) and is most likely the monthly-billing price, but the Monthly view could not be toggled so it is not recorded as a price. Corrected: plan prices and Free limits were previously missing.
verification.method: Opened in the Claude desktop built-in browser; page text read

profile.headline: An AI assistant that records meetings, summarises them and makes them searchable

capabilities.title: Transcribe and record meetings
capabilities.text: Transcripts in 100+ languages with speaker recognition and automatic language detection.

capabilities.title: Get an AI summary
capabilities.text: Overview, bullet points, action items and custom notes for each conversation.

capabilities.title: Search past conversations
capabilities.text: AI-powered search finds what was said in earlier meetings.

capabilities.title: Get help during the meeting
capabilities.text: Live Assist gives real-time suggestions, coaching and answers.

featureCards.name: Conversation Intelligence
featureCards.text: Speaker talk-time, AI filters, sentiment analysis and topic trackers.

featureCards.name: AI Skills
featureCards.text: More than 200 skills for tasks such as extracting details, writing follow-up emails and scoring candidates.

featureCards.name: Voice Agents
featureCards.text: Run screening, discovery or check-in calls that each end with a transcript and summary.

featureCards.name: Fireflies MCP
featureCards.text: Brings meeting insights into AI tools such as Claude and ChatGPT.

featureCards.name: Many ways to capture
featureCards.text: Mobile app, desktop app, dialers and API, or upload an audio or video file.

featureCards.name: Collaboration tools
featureCards.text: Channels, user groups, comments and bookmarks, soundbites and downloads.

audienceDetail.text: The site lists both, with CRM and applicant-tracking integrations.
Both are named among the teams that use it.
Named alongside healthcare, media and venture capital.
Healthcare (HIPAA BAA) and education (FERPA DSA) needs are available on Enterprise with Private Storage.

scenarios.title: Fill in the CRM
scenarios.text: Add notes and call logs to the CRM automatically.

scenarios.title: Create follow-up tasks
scenarios.text: Send tasks to a project management tool after a meeting.

scenarios.title: Send interview notes to an ATS
scenarios.text: Pass meeting notes to Greenhouse or Lever.

scenarios.title: Watch team participation
scenarios.text: Track speaking time and sentiment across meetings.

gettingStarted.text: The site says it includes transcription, summaries and search, with no credit card required.
Link Zoom, Google Meet, Microsoft Teams or Gmail, or use the mobile, desktop or API options.
Fireflies joins meetings when invited or according to your auto-record settings, and participants can see that recording is on.
